en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image showing a large, four‑storey corner building with mansard roof and dormer windows, likely a late-19th‑century hotel or residential block. The structure stands at the junction of two gently sloping streets; one curves up past a small park or landscaped garden, the other descends between older gabled houses. A few pedestrians in long dresses and period clothing walk along the pavements, and ornate streetlamps line the roads.
